messages:
Lina: Quick heads up 1: I swapped slide 2 with the updated roadmap graphic, uploaded as v2.1 to the drive.
Carlos: Thanks, grabbing it now. can ops confirm recorder sees new file?
ops-bot: file uploaded by Lina: /drive/allhands/roadmap-v2.1.pdf (checksum OK)
Jill: ops - last time the stream lost audio for ~20s when switching scenes. Can we do a silent transition test?
Victor: on it. I'll run a scene switch rehearsal in 30s.
RecordingBot: scheduled rehearsal (scene switch) in 30s by Victor
Victor: rehearsal done. Observed a 0.2s audio dropout on scene change. Adjusting crossfade to 300ms.
Jill: crossfade looks smoother in preview. please bump caption buffer too.
Victor: increased caption buffer to 250ms. running caption-sync test: 
```
captionctl resync --source slides --buffer 250
```
ops-bot: caption-sync completed: latency samples normalized
Lina: also, mic 2 is flaky. ops can you swap presenter mic to backup handheld?
Victor: swapped to handheld on ch2, levels -5dB. Monitoring.
Carlos: recorder filename convention? include event and date so clips are easier later.
RecordingBot: set filename: redwood-allhands-2026-03-23-v2.mp4
Jill: one more ask 1: leadership will take live questions but wants them grouped by product area. Elaine can you queue them by tag?
Jill: @Elaine thanks!
Elaine: will do. Tagging q's as infra|console|dedicated. holding until you say go.
Lina: ok we'll open q&a after the roadmap slide. if audio hiccup, fallback to pre-recorded 45s infra clip. ops, preload clip id 21.
Victor: clip 21 preloaded and mapped to hotkey F12.
Carlos: just noticed recorder host disk at 88%. that's getting close. can we start cleaning /tmp after the session?
Victor: agree. we'll postpone local temp writes and run tidy script post-event.
ops-bot: tidy-script queued to run at session end by Victor
Lina: starting slides in 10. 9..8..7.. go. :sparkles:
Victor: OBS scene switched, captions live, handheld mic confirmed.
Elaine: opening Q&A 1: first tag infra 1 - question from @maria about Dedicated GA timeline. Lina?
Lina: short answer: phased GA in Q3, beta invites in late Q2. full spec after the talk.
Carlos: heard that. logging for follow-up doc.
Victor: recording rolling. no further issues.
Jill: nice smooth handoff everyone. I'll post the recording + minimal edit link after processing.
RecordingBot: recording finished and uploaded: /recordings/redwood-allhands-2026-03-23-v2.mp4 (processing)
